description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapView' responsible for rendering an interactive mind map visualization of recommended roles based on user filters and recommendations fetched from API endpoints. It manages state for roles, viewport, selection, and loading/error statuses, and uses several helper functions for data parsing and filtering.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes an input value to a trimmed string representation.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the role ID from a role object using various potential fields.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object with support for multiple possible fields.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between a specified min and max.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range data from a role object, returning min and max in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role object matches selected industry, skills, and salary range filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations from API endpoints based on a persona ID.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts stored view state into viewport object with pan and zoom.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport object and selected node ID into stored view state.
